Package io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.settings

Class GlobalSettings

java.lang.Object
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.settings.GlobalSettings
public class GlobalSettings extends Object
DTO for GeoServer global settings. Maps GET /rest/settings.
